improvements: Tiered title selector: Tier 1 = exact match or '<name>:' prefix, Tier 2 = standalone word, Tier 3 = loose regex match, Tier 4 = body-only
Case-insensitive technique patterns (KV cache == KV Cache)
Child h3 aggregation when canonical is h2 (catches dimensions in sub-sections)
Stub-rescue: if Tier 1 body < 600 chars and a Tier 2 candidate is 10x larger, prefer Tier 2
Score-zero rescue: if Tier 1 has score 0 and Tier 2 has score > 0 with 5x larger body, prefer Tier 2
Fixed code-detection regex to also match `lang-python` (not only `language-python`)

summary: Cycle 5 improved the pedagogy audit's canonical-section picker via a 4-tier selector with stub-rescue and score-zero fallback rules, exposing real coverage gaps that the v3 picker had been masking with false positives. Two scoring bugs were also fixed: code-block detection now matches both `language-python` and `lang-python` class conventions, and technique patterns are case-insensitive so 'KV cache' and 'KV Cache' are treated identically. Across 18 HTML files, ~50 dimensions (figures, math, code blocks, worked examples) were added to fill the real gaps the improved audit surfaced. The 4/4-coverage technique count rose from 70 (v3) to 98 (v4 final), and load-bearing techniques with score <=2 dropped from 27 to 1 (the sole remainder is RVQ in section-75.4.html, where an HTML parser quirk pulls in unrelated DNABERT content).
